comment: The Haro v0.2 conformance floor, written BEFORE the court that passes it (the W discipline: fixtures first, prose second). v0.2 grows v0.1 by the WORLD and REFINE seats the Haro charter names (section 3) and the type kinds the spike measured as missing on a real language (haro/SPIKE.md: 70 of 120 machine fixtures were rules beyond the declaration): MENU, RANGE and FORMAT as seat types with their refusal phrasing; a seat typed by a DECLARATION is a reference resolved at check time; CONSTRAINT carries a condition in a closed language over a declaration's seats; WORLD declares cardinality and position; REFINE declares the refinable points, their kinds (RFN's six, per D6) and their trust floors. Every v0.1 fixture still passes: v0.2 refuses nothing v0.1 accepted. Rejects carry the fragment the refusal must contain.

accepts.name: a MENU is a seat type: the word must be one of its WORDS, and the menu speaks its own refusal
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE m AS (VERSION "0.2", GRAMMAR "0.2", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".m") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE MENU restart_policy AS (WORDS [never, always, on_failure], MESSAGE "RESTART is never, always or on_failure") RATIONALE "the restart menu is closed"
DEFINE DECLARATION service AS (VERB "SERVICE", SEATS [restart: restart_policy?]) RATIONALE "x"

accepts.name: a RANGE is a seat type for numbers, MIN to MAX inclusive
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE m AS (VERSION "0.2", GRAMMAR "0.2", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".m") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE RANGE health_window AS (MIN 1, MAX 3600, MESSAGE "HEALTH is a window of one second to an hour") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION service AS (VERB "SERVICE", SEATS [health: health_window?]) RATIONALE "x"

accepts.name: a FORMAT is a seat type for text, its SHAPE from the closed shape menu
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE m AS (VERSION "0.2", GRAMMAR "0.2", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".m") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE FORMAT abs_path AS (SHAPE absolute_path, MESSAGE "an absolute path") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE FORMAT subnet AS (SHAPE cidr) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION mount AS (VERB "MOUNT", SEATS [at: abs_path]) RATIONALE "x"

accepts.name: a seat typed by a DECLARATION is a reference, resolved at check time; a list of them is a list of references
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE m AS (VERSION "0.2", GRAMMAR "0.2", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".m") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION service AS (VERB "SERVICE", SEATS [after: [service], user: user?]) RATIONALE "a service follows services and runs as a user"
DEFINE DECLARATION user AS (VERB "USER", SEATS [uid: number]) RATIONALE "x"

accepts.name: a WORLD declares cardinality and position: ONE of each listed kind per sentence, and which kind comes FIRST
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE m AS (VERSION "0.2", GRAMMAR "0.2", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".m") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION box AS (VERB "MACHINE", SEATS [profile: name]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION service AS (VERB "SERVICE", SEATS [run: [word]]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE FORM word AS (SEATS [value: text]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE WORLD machine AS (ONE [box], FIRST box) RATIONALE "a machine file declares one machine, and it comes first"

accepts.name: a CONSTRAINT with WHEN and THEN: when the condition holds on a declaration, the consequence must hold too
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE m AS (VERSION "0.2", GRAMMAR "0.2", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".m") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION box AS (VERB "MACHINE", SEATS [profile: name, kernel: name]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTRAINT hosted_runs_linux AS (ON box, WHEN "profile = hosted", THEN "kernel = linux", MESSAGE "a machine of PROFILE hosted runs on KERNEL linux") RATIONALE "the profile fixes the substrate"

accepts.name: a CONSTRAINT with WHEN alone names a forbidden state; the atoms: present, absent, contains, nonempty, unique, distinct, exists, and the ONE kind's seats
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE m AS (VERSION "0.2", GRAMMAR "0.2", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".m") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION box AS (VERB "MACHINE", SEATS [profile: name]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE MENU caps AS (WORDS [filesystem, network]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION service AS (VERB "SERVICE", SEATS [run: [word], ready: text?, needs: [caps], uid: number?]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION mount AS (VERB "MOUNT", SEATS [at: text]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE FORM word AS (SEATS [value: text]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE WORLD machine AS (ONE [box], FIRST box) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTRAINT no_root AS (ON service, WHEN "uid = 0", MESSAGE "uid 0 is the machine itself") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTRAINT run_names_a_program AS (ON service, WHEN "run empty", MESSAGE "RUN must name a program: the argv is empty") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTRAINT one_ready_path AS (ON service, WHEN "ready present and not ready unique", MESSAGE "one path signals for one service") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTRAINT needs_once AS (ON service, WHEN "not needs distinct", MESSAGE "saying it twice says nothing the once did not") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTRAINT touch_owns_no_mounts AS (ON mount, WHEN "box.profile = touch", MESSAGE "The touch profile owns no mounts") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTRAINT sees_needs_a_mount AS (ON service, WHEN "needs contains filesystem and not exists mount", MESSAGE "there is no sight to apportion") RATIONALE "x"

accepts.name: a REFINE declares the refinable POINTS with their kinds (RFN's six) and the trust FLOOR of the ones that have one
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE m AS (VERSION "0.2", GRAMMAR "0.2", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".m") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION service AS (VERB "SERVICE", SEATS [restart: name?, ready: text?]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION box AS (VERB "MACHINE", SEATS [profile: name]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE REFINE machine AS (POINTS [service.restart: knob, service.ready: field, box.profile: policy], FLOOR [service.restart: external, box.profile: trusted]) RATIONALE "a restart policy is a knob any external actor may turn; the profile is policy, and only a trusted actor touches it"

accepts.name: NAMES on a declaration: its names are drawn from a MENU
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE m AS (VERSION "0.2", GRAMMAR "0.2", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".m") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE MENU capabilities AS (WORDS [filesystem, process, network], MESSAGE "is not a capability: the menu is filesystem, process, network") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION capability AS (VERB "CAPABILITY", NAMES capabilities, SEATS [grant: name]) RATIONALE "the name IS the capability"

accepts.name: a v0.1 declaration is a v0.2 declaration: the machine language's pinned file, unchanged
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE machine AS (
  VERSION "0.1",
  GRAMMAR "0.1",
  COURT "declarative/machine/fixtures.json",
  EXTENSION ".machine"
) RATIONALE "A machine declared whole"

DEFINE FORM word AS (
  SEATS [value: text]
) RATIONALE "One word of a service's argv"

DEFINE DECLARATION box AS (
  VERB "MACHINE",
  SEATS [profile: name, arch: name, kernel: name, libc: name?, board: name?, console: text?]
) RATIONALE "The one identity declaration"

DEFINE DECLARATION service AS (
  VERB "SERVICE",
  SEATS [run: [word], restart: name?, ready: text?]
) RATIONALE "A process the machine keeps"

DEFINE REFUSAL unknown_verb AS (
  MESSAGE "The machine verb set is closed (DEFINE)."
) RATIONALE "The closure speaks"

rejects.name: a MENU requires its WORDS
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE m AS (VERSION "0.2", GRAMMAR "0.2", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".m") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE MENU restart_policy AS (MESSAGE "x") RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: a MENU names at least one word
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE m AS (VERSION "0.2", GRAMMAR "0.2", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".m") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE MENU restart_policy AS (WORDS []) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: a RANGE's MIN is not above its MAX
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE m AS (VERSION "0.2", GRAMMAR "0.2", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".m") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE RANGE r AS (MIN 10, MAX 1) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: a FORMAT's SHAPE is drawn from the closed shape menu
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE m AS (VERSION "0.2", GRAMMAR "0.2", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".m") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE FORMAT f AS (SHAPE regex) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: a seat type still resolves to something: a MENU, a RANGE, a FORMAT, a FORM, an EXPRESSION or a DECLARATION
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE m AS (VERSION "0.2", GRAMMAR "0.2", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".m") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION service AS (VERB "SERVICE", SEATS [restart: policy]) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: at most one WORLD
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE m AS (VERSION "0.2", GRAMMAR "0.2", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".m") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION box AS (VERB "MACHINE", SEATS [profile: name]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE WORLD w1 AS (ONE [box]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE WORLD w2 AS (FIRST box) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: ONE names declarations of this language
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE m AS (VERSION "0.2", GRAMMAR "0.2", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".m") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION box AS (VERB "MACHINE", SEATS [profile: name]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE WORLD w AS (ONE [fleet]) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: FIRST names a DECLARATION, not a FORM
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE m AS (VERSION "0.2", GRAMMAR "0.2", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".m") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE FORM word AS (SEATS [value: text]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION box AS (VERB "MACHINE", SEATS [run: [word]]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE WORLD w AS (FIRST word) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: a CONSTRAINT is ON a declaration of this language
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE m AS (VERSION "0.2", GRAMMAR "0.2", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".m") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION box AS (VERB "MACHINE", SEATS [profile: name]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTRAINT c AS (ON fleet, WHEN "profile = hosted", MESSAGE "x") RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: a condition names the declaration's own seats
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE m AS (VERSION "0.2", GRAMMAR "0.2", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".m") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION box AS (VERB "MACHINE", SEATS [profile: name]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTRAINT c AS (ON box, WHEN "colour = blue", MESSAGE "x") RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: a condition is a sentence of the closed condition language, not an expression of anything else
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE m AS (VERSION "0.2", GRAMMAR "0.2", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".m") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION box AS (VERB "MACHINE", SEATS [profile: name]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTRAINT c AS (ON box, WHEN "profile = hosted and", MESSAGE "x") RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: a REFINE point is a seat of a declaration of this language
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE m AS (VERSION "0.2", GRAMMAR "0.2", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".m") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION service AS (VERB "SERVICE", SEATS [restart: name?]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE REFINE r AS (POINTS [service.colour: knob]) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: a point's kind is one of RFN's six: knob, field, symbol, policy, composite, pipeline
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE m AS (VERSION "0.2", GRAMMAR "0.2", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".m") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION service AS (VERB "SERVICE", SEATS [restart: name?]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE REFINE r AS (POINTS [service.restart: dial]) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: a FLOOR is a posture: trusted, external, sandboxed or llm
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE m AS (VERSION "0.2", GRAMMAR "0.2", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".m") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION service AS (VERB "SERVICE", SEATS [restart: name?]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE REFINE r AS (POINTS [service.restart: knob], FLOOR [service.restart: anyone]) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: a FLOOR stands on a declared point
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE m AS (VERSION "0.2", GRAMMAR "0.2", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".m") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION service AS (VERB "SERVICE", SEATS [restart: name?, ready: text?]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE REFINE r AS (POINTS [service.restart: knob], FLOOR [service.ready: trusted]) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: NAMES names a MENU
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE m AS (VERSION "0.2", GRAMMAR "0.2", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".m") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE FORM word AS (SEATS [value: text]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION capability AS (VERB "CAPABILITY", NAMES word, SEATS [grant: name]) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: at most one REFINE
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE m AS (VERSION "0.2", GRAMMAR "0.2", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".m") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION service AS (VERB "SERVICE", SEATS [restart: name?]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE REFINE r1 AS (POINTS [service.restart: knob]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE REFINE r2 AS (POINTS [service.restart: knob]) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: a condition's KIND.seat atom names a ONE kind, because only then is there one declaration to read
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE m AS (VERSION "0.2", GRAMMAR "0.2", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".m") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION box AS (VERB "MACHINE", SEATS [profile: name]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION mount AS (VERB "MOUNT", SEATS [at: text]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTRAINT c AS (ON mount, WHEN "box.profile = touch", MESSAGE "x") RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: exists names a declaration of this language
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE m AS (VERSION "0.2", GRAMMAR "0.2", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".m") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION box AS (VERB "MACHINE", SEATS [profile: name]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTRAINT c AS (ON box, WHEN "exists fleet", MESSAGE "x") RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: a list seat's element is a FORM, a DECLARATION or a MENU, never an EXPRESSION
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE m AS (VERSION "0.2", GRAMMAR "0.2", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".m") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE EXPRESSION cond AS (OPERATORS [cmp], OPERANDS [number]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION service AS (VERB "SERVICE", SEATS [after: [service], guards: [cond]]) RATIONALE "x"
